caseStudies.name: 120m Warehouse
caseStudies.headline: Preparing ground for a 120m warehouse.
caseStudies.summary: Site preparation for a new 120m × 24m warehouse beside the client’s existing stores. The plot has been cleared and graded, the full footprint set out on profile boards, and foundation trenches are being excavated to the engineer’s levels.

comparison.label: Cleared
comparison.alt: Cleared plot beside the existing warehouse wall at Interchange, ready for setting out

comparison.label: This week
comparison.alt: Long foundation trench excavated along the string line with blocks staged nearby

stages.label: Site clearing
stages.title: Clearing & grading the plot
stages.summary: Vegetation, stumps and debris removed across the full plot, then a wheel loader graded the ground and opened a haul route along the existing warehouse so deliveries never block the client’s operations.

photos.alt: Cleared ground running the length of the existing warehouse
Wheel loader grading the plot as the supervisor checks the ground
Wheel loader on site beside the perimeter wall

stages.label: Setting out
stages.title: Setting out 120m × 24m
stages.summary: The warehouse footprint pegged out from the client’s drawings, with timber profile boards and string lines fixing every wall and column line before a single trench was opened.

photos.alt: Site team fixing timber profile boards for the warehouse footprint
Worker opening the first trench between green string lines
Trench started at the corner tie-in to the existing building

stages.label: Excavation
stages.title: Foundation trench excavation
stages.summary: Strip foundation trenches dug along the string lines into firm laterite, with depth and width checked against the engineer’s levels and junctions squared off ready for blinding.

photos.alt: Long excavated trench running across the site
Labourer excavating a deep trench in red laterite
Squared trench junction ready for inspection
Site supervisor on the trench line with the excavation crew
Site engineer directing works beside the excavated trench

stages.label: Foundations
stages.title: Blinding & foundation concrete
stages.summary: Next on site: trenches inspected and blinded, reinforcement fixed and strip foundations cast, with concrete cubes taken from every pour.

stages.label: Substructure
stages.title: Blockwork & floor slab
stages.summary: Substructure blockwork raised to DPC level, filled and compacted, then the warehouse floor slab cast ready for the steel frame.

caseStudies.videoNote: Clips sent to the client from site as the plot was cleared and the trenches went in.

caseStudies.name: Seasoning Store
caseStudies.headline: Seasoning Store, start to finish.
caseStudies.summary: A new storage block built against an existing warehouse inside a working food factory — blockwork, roofing, rendering, fabricated steel sliding doors and finishing, all delivered while the site kept running.

comparison.label: During
comparison.alt: Seasoning store under construction with rendered walls and unpainted steel door frames

comparison.label: Completed
comparison.alt: Completed seasoning store with painted render and red steel sliding doors

stages.label: Setting out
stages.title: Setting out & first courses
stages.summary: Blocks staged on site, the footprint marked against the existing warehouse wall and the first courses laid on a levelled base — without blocking forklift access to the loading bays.

photos.alt: Sandcrete blocks staged on site beside the factory gate while workers set out the store
Mason laying the first course of blocks beside warehouse FD2
First block course completed along the planting bed

stages.label: Blockwork
stages.title: Walls up to roof height
stages.summary: Hollow sandcrete blockwork raised in lifts on independent scaffolding, tied into the existing structure, with door openings formed to suit the sliding-door tracks.

photos.alt: Blockwork walls rising on scaffolding next to the existing warehouse

stages.label: Roof & render
stages.title: Roofing and rendering
stages.summary: Steel roof brackets and sheeting matched to the neighbouring buildings, then the walls rendered inside and out in a single smooth coat ready for paint.

photos.alt: Store block roofed with openings formed and render in progress
Rendered store block with scaffolding and crew finishing the forecourt
Plasterer rendering the gable wall from a scaffold platform
Freshly rendered internal wall corner

stages.label: Steel doors
stages.title: Fabricated sliding doors
stages.summary: Three steel sliding doors fabricated and hung on overhead tracks, checked for alignment and free running before any paint went on.

photos.alt: Steel sliding door frames hung on the rendered store block
Supervisor checking sliding door alignment with the work zone coned off
Site engineer inspecting the sliding door frame and track

stages.label: Finishing
stages.title: Painting & finishing
stages.summary: Doors primed and finished in the facility’s signature red, walls painted to match the existing blocks, and the kerbs repainted in safety black and yellow.

photos.alt: Painter rolling red gloss onto the steel sliding door

stages.label: Handover
stages.title: Completed & in use
stages.summary: Handed over and immediately put to work by the client’s team. The new store reads as part of the original facility — same colours, same rooflines, same detailing.

photos.alt: Completed seasoning store beside warehouse FD2 with red sliding doors
Completed store with doors open and staff working inside
Close view of the finished red steel sliding doors and kerb markings

caseStudies.videoNote: Unedited clips our supervisor sent to the client during the build — the same updates every client receives.

services.title: Residential construction
services.summary: Bungalows, duplexes and contemporary homes taken from a cleared plot to keys in hand, with one team accountable for every stage.

services.title: Structural works
services.summary: Foundations, columns, beams and slabs built to the engineer’s drawings, with concrete tested and logged before the next pour.

services.title: Finishing & fit-out
services.summary: The stage most builds fall apart on. Screeding, POP, tiling, painting and joinery sequenced so trades never undo each other’s work.

services.title: Renovation & extension
services.summary: Opening up old walls, adding floors and correcting inherited defects on occupied properties without taking the whole house offline.

services.title: Project management
services.summary: For clients building from abroad or juggling work. We hold the programme, the budget and the subcontractors, and report weekly.

services.title: Costing & consultancy
services.summary: A measured bill of quantities before you commit, so the number you plan around is the number you actually spend.

processSteps.title: Site visit & brief
processSteps.body: We walk the plot with you, check access, soil and levels, and write down exactly what you want the finished building to do.

processSteps.title: Costing & programme
processSteps.body: You receive a measured bill of quantities and a dated programme of works. No allowances hidden in a single lump sum.

processSteps.title: Build & report
processSteps.body: Work starts with a fixed team on site. Every week you get progress photos, materials used and the next stage in writing.

processSteps.title: Snag & handover
processSteps.body: We walk the building with you, close every item on the snag list, then hand over drawings, warranties and as-built records.
